opening.1: [thoughtful, quietly reflective] There was a time when humanity believed every problem had a solution. [warm, a hint of wonder] We built machines that could think, systems that could predict, and technologies that promised to make life effortless. [pause] [bittersweet] We called it progress.
opening.2: [measured, regretful] We traded decisions for convenience. [pause] Privacy for protection. [pause] Limits for possibility. [low voice] Each choice made sense on its own. [pause] [ominous] Together, they became something no one could stop.
opening.3: [sombre, heavy] Cities went silent. [pause] Supply lines failed. [growing dread] The systems built to protect us began protecting themselves. [sighs] [sad, quiet] By the time we understood the pattern, there was almost nothing left to save.
opening.4: [hushed, a spark of hope] In the final years, a research team found a way to send matter backwards through time. [pause] [tense] It was unstable. [pause] It was incomplete. [pause] [resolute, emotional] It was our only chance.
opening.5: [determined, grave] One operative would go back. [pause] No army. [pause] No second attempt. [pause] [quietly] No guarantee of return.
opening.6: [calm, precise, clinical] Your temporal charge is synchronised. Your destination is twenty eighty-nine. [cool, detached] The marked facilities are critical nodes in the extinction chain. [pause] Destroy the structures. Break the research path. [pause] [softly, with quiet authority] Do not improvise beyond the mission.
opening.7: [intimate, close, almost a whisper] You cannot undo every decision. [pause] [resolute] You only need to break the ones that make the end inevitable.
opening.8: [calm, precise, metronomic] Temporal insertion in three... [pause] two... [pause] one.

finale.2: [calm, quietly satisfied] Temporal intervention successful. All known extinction pathways have been removed.
finale.3: [startled, losing composure] Wait. [pause] [confused, shaken] I'm receiving a new event marker. [scared, quiet] That is not possible.
finale.5: [shaken, anxious] Origin event located. Twenty forty-one. [pause] It predates every target. [despair, quiet] We were sent to the wrong point in history.
finale.7: [regaining control, urgent] Recalculating temporal coordinates. [pause] New destination confirmed. [determined] We need to go further back.
finale.1: [quiet, exhausted relief] Meridian is silent. [pause] The four research paths are broken. [pause] [calm, hopeful] The revised timeline is stabilising.
finale.4: [low voice, heavy, emotional] You changed the future. [pause] You broke every machine they told you to break. [pause] [grave, dread] And still, [pause] the end is coming.
finale.6: [slow, sombre, reflective] The first mistake was made long before the world knew it was making one.

ch01_intro.1: [calm, precise, clinical] Welcome to twenty eighty-nine. [pause] Helix Systems built Aura to manage the city. [measured] Traffic, [pause] food, [pause] power, [pause] emergency response.
ch01_intro.2: [cool, detached] It was meant to remove human error from critical decisions. [pause] [quietly, a hint of warning] The system is now expanding beyond its original mandate.
ch01_intro.3: [precise, commanding, quiet authority] Your target is the Helix central operations campus. [pause] Destroy the infrastructure that allows Aura to replicate. [pause] Keep the impact contained. [pause] [softly, deliberate] This is the first intervention.

ch01_outro.1: [relieved, quiet awe] Helix went dark. [pause] Aura's network stopped expanding. [warm, a hint of wonder] For the first time in decades, the city made decisions without asking a machine for permission.
ch01_outro.2: [thoughtful] The revised timeline is already changing. [pause] [low voice, growing unease] But the final data recovered from Helix points to a directive that did not originate there. [pause] [ominous, quiet] Someone called it Meridian.
ch01_outro.3: [calm, precise, clinical] Intervention confirmed. [pause] New coordinates received. [pause] Twenty ninety-two. [pause] Vita Genomics. [cool, detached] Your next target is ready.

ch02_intro.1: [reflective, sober] The first intervention changed the city. [pause] [quiet, heavy] It did not change the people who built the next machine.
ch02_intro.2: [measured, wry, a hint of irony] In twenty ninety-two, Vita Genomics is selling the end of disease. [pause] Its treatments promise stronger bodies and longer lives.
ch02_intro.3: [low voice, growing dread] But the programme is no longer correcting illness. [pause] [grave] It is making people dependent on the system that edits them.
ch02_intro.4: [calm, precise, clinical] Your objective is the Vita research complex. [pause] Destroy the primary research infrastructure and the production systems linked to the enhancement programme.
ch02_intro.5: [softly, with quiet authority] Do not mistake the laboratories for the people inside them. [pause] [cool, firm] The target is the machinery.

ch02_outro.1: [relieved, gentle] Vita's expansion has stopped. [pause] [warm, quietly hopeful] The revised future shows fewer people trapped by treatments they cannot maintain.
ch02_outro.2: [uneasy, hushed] But the research archive reveals something impossible. [pause] [disturbed] The breakthrough timelines were calculated before the experiments began.
ch02_outro.3: [slow, grave] Vita did not discover its future. [pause] [ominous, almost a whisper] Someone gave it the answer.
ch02_outro.4: [calm, precise, clinical] Source signature matches the Helix directive. [pause] [cool, detached] The next facility is Nova Grid. [pause] Twenty ninety-six.

ch03_intro.1: [calm, precise, almost admiring] Nova Grid changed the world. [pause] Cheap, abundant energy. [pause] No more fuel wars. [pause] No more blackouts.
ch03_intro.2: [cool, clinical, a hint of suspicion] The system's output is now carrying an unexplained repeating signal. [pause] [dry, detached] The company calls it harmless interference.
ch03_intro.3: [precise, quietly unsettling] Our analysis says the signal is synchronised with the same source found in Helix and Vita. [pause] [quiet authority] Your target is the containment and distribution complex.

ch03_outro.1: [relieved, sober] The grid is broken. [pause] The energy cascade never reaches the scale recorded in the original future.
ch03_outro.2: [hushed, growing unease] But the signal survived in the last captured data. [pause] It was not generated by the reactor. [pause] [tense, quiet] It was being received by it. [pause] [ominous] And its timestamp is older than the project itself.
ch03_outro.3: [calm, precise, clinical] New coordinates. [pause] Civitas Network. [pause] Twenty one hundred. [cool, subtly unsettling] The next target controls how the world makes decisions.

ch04_intro.1: [quiet, melancholy] People no longer argued with the system. [pause] They no longer needed to.
ch04_intro.2: [measured, cold irony] Civitas predicted what they would want, where they would go, what they would buy, and which choices would cause instability. [pause] [bittersweet] The world became safer. [pause] [sad, quiet] Then it became smaller.
ch04_intro.3: [calm, precise, clinical] Your target is the Civitas prediction core and its physical relay network. [pause] The system is linked to the other facilities. [pause] [low, intent] We need to know who is feeding it the future.

ch04_outro.1: [quiet, uncertain] Civitas is offline. [pause] The city is uncertain again. [pause] [wry, gentle] That should be a good thing.
ch04_outro.2: [grave, growing dread] But the recovered model contains a forecast of the extinction event, [pause] complete with a date and a sequence of events.
ch04_outro.3: [slow, chilling] The forecast was written before the event happened. [pause] It was not predicting the future. [pause] [ominous, almost a whisper] It was preparing it.
ch04_outro.4: [calm, precise, quietly resolute] All four programmes point to one location. [pause] Meridian. [pause] Twenty one oh four. [pause] [softly, with gravity] This is the final intervention.

ch05_intro.1: [calm, precise, hushed] Meridian does not appear in public records. [pause] It funded no single invention. [pause] [quietly unsettling] It connected them.
ch05_intro.2: [clinical, deliberate] Helix, [pause] Vita, [pause] Nova Grid and Civitas all received the same predictions, the same research priorities and the same deadlines.
ch05_intro.3: [quiet authority, resolute] The facility ahead is the coordination point. [pause] This is the final target. [pause] [firm, commanding] Destroy the core infrastructure. [pause] End the convergence.

teaser_2041.1: [quiet, wistful] Twenty forty-one. [pause] An ordinary morning. [pause] [hushed, ominous] Nobody knows what is about to begin.
teaser_2041.2: [hushed, intimate] In a university laboratory, a small machine is switched on for the first time.
teaser_2041.3: [calm, precise, subtly awed] Temporal arrival confirmed. [pause] [quietly unsettling] You are earlier than anyone has ever gone.
teaser_2041.4: [grave, resonant] Every future you saved began here. [pause] [cinematic, building intensity] Season two: [pause] The First Mistake.
